name: usmon-shashlik
description: USMON SHASHLIK — Telegram Mini App + Admin Panel + Node.js Backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix admin install
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin
scripts.render:build: npm run install:all && npx prisma generate --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build
scripts.render:start: npx prisma db push --schema=backend/prisma/schema.prisma && node backend/prisma/seed.js && node backend/src/index.js

author: USMON SHASHLIK
